paragraphs: I really enjoyed my time with the Urology department at Nagoya University Hospital. I learned a lot about the healthcare system in Japan through my colleagues. They also took me out to dinners and parties. Through the department, I got to attend 16th Urological Association of Asia Congress 2018 in Kyoto and explored Kyoto too. I would like to thank the department and the office of international students for this opportunity and for being such great hosts!
